submission.natural_language_explanation: Fires when the current noun phrase or subject is plural, peaking on plural suffix morphemes (-s plurals such as characters, figures, spells, periods; group suffixes such as -men, -ers, -ans, -ats and non-English plural inflections) and on the immediately following function word (auxiliary, determiner, adjective) that agrees with or continues that plural phrase; the same frame with a singular or mass noun does not activate it.
